summary: Block count and timeline: 2-2.8 million blocks (avg 2.4M, reduced to ~2M); DMJM-Lehner study estimates completion in ~10 years at 180 blocks/hour; most sources say ~20 years.
content: DMJM-Lehner construction management study estimates 2-2.8 million blocks (average 2.4 million), reduced to ~2 million after subtracting hollow spaces. Most sources agree on a number above 2.3 million. Study suggests completion in approximately 10 years, sustaining 180 blocks per hour (3 blocks/minute) with ten-hour workdays. Other sources say the Great Pyramid was completed in ~20 years. Blocks average 2.5 tons, with some granite beams up to 60-80 tons.
